title: Luisana Lopilato gave a spicy yet fun statement about Michael Bublé
text:
ARGENTINA
Luisana Lopilato gave a spicy yet fun statement about Michael Bublé
His phrase, full of humor and affection, quickly went viral on social media
 Luisana Lopilato made headlines again after leaving a spicy and fun statement about her relationship with Canadian singer Michael Bublé, during an interview on the radio show Agarrate Catalina (La Once Diez). Her phrase, full of humor and affection, quickly went viral on social media and caused all kinds of comments among her followers.
"I keep his fans on a short leash. I'm there, I like to be present. It's important to be there because my husband is very hot," Luisana said with a laugh, making it clear that Bublé's magnetism among his admirers worldwide doesn't go unnoticed.
Luisana and Michael have been married since 2011 and have four children. Their love story captured the public's attention not only because of their international careers but also because of the way they present themselves together, natural, in sync, and always with a good dose of humor.
During the interview, Lopilato shared an anecdote that demonstrates how they handle fame and public affection. "Once he went to The View with a lock on his pants zipper. You have to do those things. I can't leave him alone," she joked, making the host and listeners laugh.
Although she acknowledged that her husband is "not jealous at all," Luisana admitted that she is a bit more protective: "I'm a little more like 'hey, I'm here, calm down.'" With these words, she made it clear that although she fully trusts her partner, she doesn't sit idly by when it comes to marking her territory with charm.
These kinds of statements reflect the authentic style of the actress, who often speaks without filters and with a lot of freshness about her family life, far from traditional celebrity strategies.
Besides humor, Luisana has also shown firmness in difficult moments. In previous interviews, she confronted unfounded accusations on social media involving her husband, even revealing that Bublé received death threats. Back then, the actress expressed her outrage and vehemently defended her family.
"Spreading love and solidarity is more necessary than ever," she said at the time, sending a clear message about the values she tries to convey in her personal and professional life.
➡️ Argentina
